title: Bug Repair
goal: Fix a reproducible bug with a focused regression test and no unrelated behavior changes
current_state: A failure has been observed, but root cause and safe repair boundary still need inspection
constraints: Do not claim the bug is fixed without rerunning the failing path
verifiers: Regression test fails before the fix and passes after
Diff contains no unrelated formatting churn

browser_verification: Use Browser only when the bug is visible in UI
forbidden_areas: Do not change public API unless the bug requires it and the user agrees
harness.local_secrets: No secrets needed for this loop.
cost_strategy: Use stronger models for unclear root cause
Use cheaper models for repeated test runs and cleanup
